scope: HITL-001 pending-approval phase only. The Temporal workflow-state test and disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO public-process check cover a waiting Approval before and after runtime API restart. Private Broker seeding is test setup only. This is not a model-provider, Workspace service, protected sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or browser claim.

observations.workflow_state: A claimed durable input route reaches the Session workflow while its Turn is waiting for approval, continues as new at the intended workflow boundary, and creates no model invocation.
observations.durable_public_restart: The disposable runtime API-process check reads the caller-owned pending Approval and waiting Turn through fresh public HTTP/SDK clients before and after an actual runtime API process restart, then decides and idempotently replays through the public boundary.
observations.safety: The retained observations contain no descriptor bytes, capability value, credential, grant ID, backend handle, or raw request content.

redaction: No DSNs, object-store credentials, tokens, raw tenant/session/turn/approval IDs, descriptors, input bytes, artifacts, backend endpoints, or provider credentials are retained.
